memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The plunder remaining from the spoils that the soldiers took was 675,000 sheep, 72,000 cattle, 61,000 donkeys and 32,000 women who had never slept with a man. The half share of those who fought in the battle was: 337,500 sheep, of which the tribute for the Lord was 675; 36,000 cattle, of which the tribute for the Lord was 72; 30,500 donkeys, of which the tribute for the Lord was 61; 16,000 people, of which the tribute for the Lord was 32. - Num 31:32-40 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
At first glance these long lists of numbers can feel dry — page after page of sheep, cattle, donkeys, and the counting of tribute. But there is something worth noticing in the very carefulness of the record. God's people did not casually estimate what belonged to the Lord; they counted precisely and gave exactly what was required. Honouring God was done with care and integrity, not carelessness.

These lists quietly teach us that God pays attention to details, and so should we in the things we do for Him. It is easy to be sloppy or approximate when it comes to giving God His due — of our time, our resources, our honesty. But the same precision that recorded 675 sheep for the Lord reminds us that our devotion is worth doing thoughtfully and accurately.

There is also a bigger picture. All this abundance was not a reward for greed or a promise of wealth — we must never read passages of plenty as a prosperity guarantee. It was simply the provision that flowed from a specific historical event, carefully stewarded and shared. What God multiplies, He expects to be handled with faithfulness.

The One who counts sheep and cattle also numbers the hairs on your head (Luke 12:7). The carefulness of these records is a small window into a God who overlooks nothing and forgets no one. You are never lost in the crowd to Him.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you honour God with care and integrity, or carelessly?
2. How does it comfort you that God attends to the smallest details?
3. Where might you need to bring more faithfulness to what you handle for God?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You count and care for even the smallest things, including me. Help me to serve You with integrity and to handle all You give me faithfully. Amen.
